item.title: Politician On Epstein List Grilled By Other Politicians On Epstein List
item.description: CHAPPAQUA, NY — A lifelong politician whose name appeared on the Epstein list was questioned today by other politicians whose names were on the Epstein list, sources confirmed.

item.title: 10 Amazing Perks Of Becoming A Protestant
item.description: Catholics (and, to a lesser extent, Orthodox) like to sneer at Protestants, but being a Protestant comes with some amazing perks. For example, did you know you're basically your own pope? You can issue papal bulls about what to watch on TV or where to order food. It's great.

item.title: Bold Right-Wing Truth-Teller Very Carefully Chooses Words So As Not To Speak Truths That Would Anger Own Audience
item.description: U.S. — Shockwaves were felt among the conservative influencer sphere this week, as one bold, right-wing truth-teller very carefully chose his words so as not to speak truths that could potentially anger his own audience.

item.title: Iran Says They Will Rain Death And Destruction On The U.S. If They Are Bombed Two More Times
item.description: GENEVA — Amid ongoing negotiations over Tehran's nuclear program, Iran's Supreme Leader unequivocally informed the United States that they would rain death and destruction down upon them if they were bombed two more times. Maybe three.

item.title: Cruel: Trump Admin Strips Funding From Gas-Station Daycare Center With 20,000 Students
item.description: SHOREVIEW, MN — In the latest in a long line of cruel, heartless atrocities it has committed, the Trump administration has just stripped federal funding from a gas station daycare center with 20,000 students.

item.title: Genius Dad Joins TikTok, Causing Teenage Daughter To Think It’s Lame
item.description: ST. GEORGE, UT — Local dad Sam Weaver struck a fatal blow against his teenage daughter's obsession with TikTok on Thursday by joining it himself, therefore rendering it uncool.
